findings.issue: isRevisionRangeToken reads any token with '..' between two non-dot, non-slash characters as a git revision range, so a file-list review target whose path holds '..' inside a name (for example docs/notes..v2.md) is routed to scopeInsideTouchedFiles. With no reviewScopeFiles on record that path returns true, so the review-target relevance check admits every scope (fail-open) instead of narrowing to the named file. Reach is narrow: an operator-supplied file target with a double-dot file name. Hardening only, since no caller is known to send one. A fix could require the range's two sides to have no '/' or file extension, or fall back to path containment when reviewScopeFiles is empty.
